packageRules.description: tracing-opentelemetry requires an exact opentelemetry minor, so a PR bumping one without the other cannot compile. Grouping batches them into a single PR; the release age holds an opentelemetry bump back long enough for the tracing-opentelemetry release that pairs with it to appear, since the two ship from different repositories days apart.
Crates from the wasmtime repository are published in lockstep and must be upgraded together.
Only raise Cargo PRs when the manifest requirement itself has to change; in-range bumps are picked up by the weekly lock file maintenance.
